candidate.title: Added value `seLinuxOptions` to istio-cni chart
candidate.text: Added value `seLinuxOptions` to istio-cni chart. On some platforms (e.g. OpenShift) it is necessary to set `seLinuxOptions.type` to `spc_t` in order to work around some SELinux constraints related to hostPath volumes. Without this setting, the istio-cni-nodes pods may fail to start.

evidence.excerpt:
- |
  **Added** value `seLinuxOptions` to istio-cni chart. On some platforms (e.g. OpenShift) it is necessary to set 
  `seLinuxOptions.type` to `spc_t` in order to work around some SELinux constraints related to hostPath volumes. 
  Without this setting, the istio-cni-nodes pods may fail to start.
